NO_DEPARTMENT: Unable to route this complaint — no department is configured
INVALID: This does not look like a valid civic complaint
NOT_YOUR_DEPARTMENT: You can only update complaints assigned to your department
DEPARTMENT_NOT_FOUND: Target department not found or is inactive
SAME_DEPARTMENT: Complaint is already assigned to this department

COMPLAINT_NOT_RESOLVED: Feedback can only be submitted for resolved complaints
FEEDBACK_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: Feedback has already been submitted for this complaint
RESOLUTION_NOTE_REQUIRED: A resolution comment is required when marking a complaint as resolved
